name: Last Mile L5: The Arms That Carry

description.value:
You learn to carry the body that cannot carry itself.

You may pick up an unconscious, bound, or Staggered creature of your size or smaller as a bonus action, without spending or reducing your remaining movement that turn (the L1 Soul speed penalty still applies only to the Soul Package, not to a creature you are physically carrying).

You may hand off a carried creature to an ally in an adjacent space as a free action. The hand-off does not provoke reactions.

You may carry a creature one size larger than yourself at half your movement speed, no Package penalty stacking — though the GM may adjudicate that this is conspicuous in tight terrain.

system.requirements: Route of the Last Mile, Shadow Courier Initiation 5
